instruction_interpretation: The owner approves the $7.00 option of AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST_002.md: one reservation of $7.00, one launch, for the checked-component two-condition pilot (cas-meta2-graph6cand-20260910120000-0a55f4b1), under the frozen design and limits recorded in this file. This is the owner's decision on the spending question the request posed; no other option in the request ($4.00 with a changed resource plan) is taken.
authorization_context: CUBE_VERIFIED_TEACHING_001 / checked component teaching - the owner-approved single two-condition pilot. Purpose: test how to spend a fixed update budget - is it better to spend some practice on the parts of a problem (five checked component route questions) rather than every update on the complete whole-part questions? The measured problem it attacks is that fresh transfer on the graph specialist has not been established (GRAPH6_CURRICULUM_002 attempt 004: VARIED_CURRICULUM_NOT_ESTABLISHED, fresh LIST_PARTS 23/180 = 12.8 per cent against FIND_SHARED_PART 71/180 = 39.4 per cent and REACHED_VIA 62/180 = 34.4 per cent). Design: two conditions from matched initial weights - checked_component_teaching (40 component corrections plus 24 whole-answer corrections per 64 updates, in eight blocks of five component questions then three whole-answer questions) and final_answer_only (0 plus 64, frozen round-robin ordering 22/21/21) - 64 updates per condition, 128 total, seed 20260909, encoder seed 20260909, arm cas, ordering mode declared, separate optimizer states and checkpoints, the same frozen encoder, framing and scoring path. Data: the pinned illustrative scene, eight teaching records covering SEVEN distinct questions (the REACHED_VIA(Bicycle, Rim) route is taught once as a component question and once as a whole-answer question, so it receives 16 corrections across the eight blocks while the other six distinct questions receive eight each), and a common 44-question untaught probe (51 catalog questions minus the 7 distinct taught; REACHED_VIA 25, FIND_SHARED_PART 14, LIST_PARTS 5) evaluated after each condition's final checkpoint with no update, never used to select a checkpoint, adjust the curriculum, or extend training. Reporting: before and after, per condition - the selected answer, all three scores and the loss for each of the three taught whole-answer questions (the primary set; one changed answer moves accuracy by 33.3 percentage points, so no single percentage carries the conclusion), the five component questions separately, and the 44 untaught probe by operation; independent and assisted figures are never merged; missing measurements are recorded as unavailable, never zero. Interpretation bound: this comparison measures how to spend a fixed budget; it does NOT isolate adding component instruction at equal final-question practice, because the control practises the final questions 64 times against 24. A negative result means this allocation did not help under these conditions, never that the seven-stage program failed - definition, analogy, correspondence and story presentations have no numerical delivery path here.
